artworks.title: Orpheus Leading Eurydice from the Underworld
artworks.description: Corot's descent — the cycle's heart: Orpheus leading Eurydice from the underworld before the fatal glance.

artworks.title: Landscape with Orpheus and Eurydice
artworks.description: Poussin's landscape — Eurydice's snakebite that opens the whole Orpheus saga.

artworks.title: Orpheus
artworks.description: Moreau's lyre and head — the cycle's aftermath distilled into Symbolist melancholy.

artworks.title: Nymphs Finding the Head of Orpheus
artworks.description: Waterhouse's nymphs — the Maenad murder's aftermath, the singing head that closes the cycle.

music.title: Hadestown
music.description: Mitchell's folk musical restages the Orpheus cycle for Broadway — the poet, the underworld factory, and the look back that loses everything.

music.title: L'Orfeo
music.description: Monteverdi's favola in musica — the Orpheus cycle's first great operatic telling, descent and glance intact.

popCulture.title: Orpheus
popCulture.description: The Thracian singer's cycle still names every artist who would charm death — Orpheus as music's myth of descent and return.
